title: VirusCraft
description:
Beautiful biomes, contraptions and... Estrogen?

Step into a world that's beautiful, expressive and immersive while still being able to face the challenges of Minecraft.
body:
# Beautiful biomes, contraptions and... Estrogen?

VirusCraft is a modpack that focuses on delivering a beautiful and immersive gameplay experience, with a heavy focus on building and aesthetics. _Create_ contraptions, explore all the biomes or forcefemme the opps with Estrogen arrows.

Step into a world packed with as many new biomes and structures as I could physically manage to insert into the game, this pack is built to look just as nice whether shaders are on or off.

![Conquer the Nether, the End and the Aether!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/68adf59629f92eb003432fb07670f3a03290daeb_0.webp)

In addition to an improved Nether and End dimensions, conquer the Aether or plant your flag on the Moon or Mars courtesy of Ad Astra!

Don't let the name fool you, everything in this pack is safe (except for 'him', we couldn't remove him this time, don't be scared - he WILL smell that)*.

![You can't see him, but I promise he can see you.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fb617de1ba4e958de23c29399139060dc2df99cd_0.webp)


* - this mod uses From the Fog to put that eerie feeling of being watched back into the game that came with Minecraft Alpha, if jumpscares and being scared aren't your thing then make sure you enable cheats when making a singleplayer world so you can disable his settings in the config command (/function fromthefog:config)
